matches.quote: Figs. S4/S5 use T_FPS and T_OCO while the main text uses T_C and T_COO; ... T_IM and T_MI are used inconsistently
JT-mode intensity is used as a measure of the AFMI-COO phase fraction without justification... calibrate JT intensity against an independent phase-fraction estimate
The observation is also what one expects from a first-order transition... on recooling from inside the hysteresis window (T_T < T_COO), part of that COO is kinetically arrested
Figure, caption and notation errors: ... the Methods say the cyclic procedure is in "figure 1 a" but it is in 1b
Resistance was measured with two probes... Contact and grain-boundary resistance contribute... repeat the key ρ data with four-probe contacts or at least check contact resistance
The laser-heating temperature scale, the x-axis of the central result, is partly circular and its uncertainty is underestimated. T_T for every laser cycle comes from Table S1
The authors should repeat the T_T sequence on a fresh spot using the cold-finger/cryostat heater for the excursion, with the Raman probe fixed at 10 mW
Non-volatility is also untested: there is no retention measurement... add... time dependence at T_B (Raman intensity and ρ for at least tens of minutes after each cycle).
The spurious peak near 660–670 cm⁻¹ (red dashed line, Fig. 2a) is attributed to "local oxygen vacancies" without evidence... its intensity in Fig. 2b changes sharply near 180–210 K.
The kinetics of the laser cycle are not specified. The dwell time at T_T, the time for the spot to reach T_T and to cool back... are not given
claims should be reduced to thermally driven, history-dependent resistivity qualitatively correlated with a separate Raman experiment, and the laser-related claims removed
No control shows that the Raman memory is thermal rather than an effect of laser exposure... Agreement would establish that the memory follows temperature and not illumination

notes: For C3, although SM Table S1 gives linear-fit error bars, the main Results text does not explain the indirect determination and the review critiques the SM calibration method and underestimated uncertainty, so fixed_in_v1 is false. For C16, both the referee and P14 flag the same erroneous 'depicted in figure 1 a' reference in the Magnetization and resistance sentence in Methods (the referee suggesting Fig. 4 and P14 suggesting Fig. 1b), scored as partly. For C9, the review argues in P7 that Raman JT intensity requires independent calibration before estimating phase fractions and in P4 that Fig. 5 should be tied to a measured phase fraction, scored as partly.
